text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(For three days and three nights, as long 
as the sun was up... I ran. Without 
stopping once, I kept running through the 
mountains.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Only the occasional chime of my device's 
alert keeps me under control.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like Trainer is right beside me, 
watching over me— That's why I can give it 
my all.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(――My breathing is starting to fall apart. 
I'm completely exhausted, and my legs feel 
so heavy...――)

text_block_list.name: Rivals
text_block_list.text: "—Haaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I hear it! I feel it...! Everyone's 
overwhelming pressure... But—!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, hehehe...! Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaargh...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I did it! It's finished...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: This is truly—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: “Daring heart”――

The final day of summer camp. Several days 
had passed since Daring Heart ventured 
deep into the mountains for her finishing 
touches. And then...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――I'm home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I wonder. Have I... changed?
choice_data_list:
...You've lost a little weight, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's what you mean? Well, we were in 
survival mode, so it couldn't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Still... that was fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When you're pushed to the absolute 
limit, where you feel you can't go on 
anymore—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Remembering how everyone ran... I was even 
able to enjoy the grueling parts!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just brave anymore. With this 
limitless engine called my heart— I can 
push past all my limits...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Formidable rivals, the wall of aptitude... 
No matter what difficulties come, it's all 
okay.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —I'll enjoy every bit of it and win!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah! Heart-san, welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You two... Were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanted to take the bus home 
together!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Let's all talk about how our summer 
went!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you can say that... you must be 
confident you've grown stronger, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Messiah, you too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I have... grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...It's so easy to tell when something's 
changed with you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What is visible. Her absolute confidence 
in herself...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I realized. And after 
that...—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I was just quietly building it up. That 
was all I ever needed to do."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—I will not yield the Shuka Sho. I swear 
it upon this blood.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! I won't lose either—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Cesario! Right now, she's helping 
me pick out snacks for the bus!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! I can't wait to see what Cesario 
chooses!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna go help Cesario! Heart, take 
the bus, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I hear those two got even stronger again. 
What should we do?
choice_data_list: We've just got to have fun and win.
We've just got to have fun and win.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Ah, I can't wait...!

And so, the intense summer training camp 
came to an end—
